# app-spec.md template

Write this file at the scaffolded app's root. Fill from interview answers;
mark defaulted values with `(default)` so the user sees what was decided for
them. The scaffold is generated FROM this file; later re-runs read it.

`app-spec.md` is **one file for two readers**: the prose below is for humans; a
single fenced `json` block (the **Machine spec**, see below) is the contract
`brand-ui scaffold` consumes. Keep the two in sync. A complete, valid example is
`app-spec.example.md`; the contract is `app-spec.schema.json` (gated by
`pnpm app-spec:check`).

```markdown
# App spec — {Title}

> Generated by brand-ui new-app on {date}. This spec is the source of truth
> for the scaffold; edit it and re-run `/new-app` to regenerate, or hand it
> to your agent as context.

## Intent

- **Purpose:** {one sentence}
- **Audience:** {who uses it}
- **Scale:** {demo | internal tool | production-bound}

## Archetype

- **{archetype}** → template `template-{archetype}`, playbook
  `playbooks/{archetype}.md`

## Surfaces & navigation

| Surface | Nav label  | Archetype   | Notes |
| ------- | ---------- | ----------- | ----- |
| {home}  | {Overview} | {dashboard} | {…}   |

## Entities

### {Entity}

| Field    | Type                  | Renders as  | Filterable | Notes |
| -------- | --------------------- | ----------- | ---------- | ----- |
| {name}   | {text}                | {text cell} | {search}   |       |
| {status} | {status: a \| b \| c} | {Badge}     | {facet}    |       |

## Brand & feel

- **Theme:** {qlik-bright} {(default)}
- **Density / decoration:** {default}

## Per-surface detail

### {Surface}

- {KPIs / columns / chart types / fields / node taxonomy — per archetype}
- {…or "defaults (see playbook)" if stage 6 was skipped}

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Renders in {theme} with no raw colors
- [ ] All WIRE points either wired or listed under Next steps
- [ ] typecheck green

## Next steps (open WIRE points)

- [ ] {file:line — what to wire, expected shape}
```

## Machine spec (required — the scaffold contract)

End the file with a single fenced `json` block under a `## Machine spec` heading.
This is what `brand-ui scaffold` reads (the prose above is for humans). It must
satisfy `app-spec.schema.json`:

- **Required:** `archetype` (one of dashboard · data-app · ai-assistant ·
  flow-workspace · settings · marketing), `theme` (slug: qlik-bright · qlik-dark ·
  blueprint), `title`.
- **Optional:** `intent` (`purpose`/`audience`/`scale`), `density`,
  `surfaces[]` (`{id, navLabel, archetype}`), `entities[]`
  (`{name, fields:[{name, type, rendersAs?, filterable?}]}`, `type` ∈ text ·
  number · date · status · boolean).

Mirrors the `planScaffold` input in the `@brand/cli` scaffold engine. See
`app-spec.example.md` for a filled-in block; validate any spec with
`pnpm app-spec:check <path>` (in a consuming project: `npx @brand/cli` + the
kit's schema).
